title: re-registering the same URL silently overwrites the JSON
description:
Researcher first-pass. Highest local-pod data-loss bug.

Re-registering an existing URL overwrites the reference JSON with no guard, merge, or warning. Researcher overwrote an accepted Compaction Cliff record with a pending dup probe, then had to restore it by hand.

Product rule: same URL in the same corpus is an identity. Re-register must refuse, or merge non-destructively, and must warn if the existing row is already accepted. Never clobber accepted why/status/title.
